narration:
In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}, but the two lives stayed the same until month {first_divergent_month}.
In month {substitution_month}, {withdrawn_choice} was not available on this path, so the ghost took {substitute_choice}.
The money was furthest apart in month {widest_gap_month}, when the ghost had {widest_gap}.
The ghost's Life ended {life_gap}, and it was nearer to only getting by.
The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last longer with no pay.
By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
